label.purpose: Component headers, stat names, section titles. Always uppercase with positive letter-spacing.

label-small.purpose: Sublabels, metadata keys in definition lists. Tighter tracking than full labels.

value.purpose: Stat numbers, HP values, modifier displays. The largest and heaviest text in any component.

value-small.purpose: Compact grids and secondary stats. Dense variant of value tier.

body.purpose: Description prose, spell text, rule content. Comfortable reading line-height.

sublabel.purpose: Captions inside tight shapes (diamond stats, hex pairs). Smallest text tier.

shadows.name: stat-press
shadows.purpose: Subtle pressed-into-surface feel on stat value chips. The single structural shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus indicator. State signal, not depth.

shadows.name: trigger-glow
shadows.purpose: Ambient glow around trigger buttons. Communicates interactivity through light emission.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover and background transitions (0.2s).

components.name: Base Button
components.description: Default interactive button. Transparent at rest, fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-base { border-radius: 0.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.4rem; border: 1px solid #383e54; background: transparent; color: #e0e0e0; } .ds-btn-base:hover { background-color: #363b4a; } .ds-btn-base:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(109, 124, 186, 0.5); }

components.name: Accent Button (Teal)
components.description: Teal-accented button for positive actions (heal, add, confirm).
components.css: .ds-btn-accent-teal { border-radius: 0.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.4rem; border: 1px solid #64d8cb; background: transparent; color: #64d8cb; } .ds-btn-accent-teal:hover { background-color: #363b4a; } .ds-btn-accent-teal:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(109, 124, 186, 0.5); }

components.name: Trigger Button
components.description: 44px circular action button with gold ring glow. Used in headers for primary actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-trigger"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #e0ac00; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 212, 0, 0.12); color: #e0ac00; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-trigger:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 212, 0, 0.18); } .ds-btn-trigger:active { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 0.96; } .ds-btn-trigger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 212, 0, 0.22); }

components.name: Primary Card
components.description: Standard container for stat displays and grouped content.
components.css: .ds-card-primary { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: start; padding: 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.4rem; background-color: #262a36; color: #e0e0e0; border: 1px solid #383e54; min-height: 80px; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #a0a0d0; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-value { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: bold; color: #ffffff; } .ds-card-sublabel { font-size: 0.7rem; color: #a0c7d0; margin-top: 0.3rem; }

components.name: Stat Diamond
components.description: Hexagonal clip-path shape holding stat values. The signature component of the system.
components.css: .ds-stat-diamond { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; margin: 0; width: 94px; height: 52px; } .ds-stat-diamond::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: #5a5450; clip-path: polygon(14% 0%, 86% 0%, 100% 50%, 86% 100%, 14% 100%, 0% 50%); } .ds-stat-diamond::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 1.5px; background-color: #2a2724; clip-path: polygon(14% 0%, 86% 0%, 100% 50%, 86% 100%, 14% 100%, 0% 50%); } .ds-diamond-value { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-size: 1.3em; font-weight: 700; color: #e3dcce; line-height: 1; } .ds-diamond-caption { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-size: 0.5em; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a09880; line-height: 1.1; margin-top: 1px; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Black track with gold fill. Used for HP, XP, and level progress.
components.css: .ds-progress-track { width: 100%; height: 0.5rem; background-color: #000000; border-radius: 0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03); } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; background-color: #FFD400; transition: width 0.3s ease; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Numeric or short-text input for stat values and modifiers.
components.css: .ds-input-field { background-color: #323748; border: 1px solid #6d7cba; border-radius: 0.25rem; color: #e0e0e0; padding: 0.3rem; text-align: center; width: 5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-input-field:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(109, 124, 186, 0.5); }

components.name: Checkbox Toggle
components.description: Square toggle for spell slots, death saves, and consumable tracking.
components.css: .ds-checkbox { position: relative; display: block; width: 20px; height: 20px; border: 1px solid #6d7cba; border-radius: 0.2rem; cursor: pointer; background-color: #323748; transition: background-color 0.1s ease; padding: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-checkbox:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(109, 124, 186, 0.5); } .ds-checkbox[aria-pressed='true'] { background-color: #6d7cba; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Inline status indicator for conditions, proficiencies, and tags.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; background-color: #323748; border-radius: 0.25rem; border: 1px solid #383e54; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #e0e0e0; }

narrative.overview:
A craftsman's workspace where every tool has its place, warm lamplight reveals precise details, and nothing exists without purpose. The system is dense with information but never cluttered; hierarchy does the heavy lifting while chrome stays minimal. Fantasy warmth emerges through color temperature and typographic weight, not through ornamentation or texture.

This system explicitly rejects SaaS blandness (white/blue corporate neutrality, hero metrics, identical card grids), gamer visual noise (neon competing panels, aggressive borders), and skeletal unstyled defaults. It also rejects the obvious path of full fantasy kitsch (heavy parchment textures, ye olde borders), choosing instead the confidence of a well-made artifact.

The system is designed to blend seamlessly with Obsidian's native UI and the companion Ribbons theme. It defers to Obsidian's theming conventions (dark/light, font stacks, spacing variables) while carrying its own identity through color temperature, density, and interaction design.
keyCharacteristics: Information density managed through typographic hierarchy, not separators
Flat surfaces with tonal layering instead of shadows
Warm amber/earth tones for game-world content; cool indigo-slate for structural UI
Interactive elements invisible at rest, responsive on engagement
Two parallel palettes: structural (plugin tokens) and thematic (Obsidian vars + light-dark)

rules.name: The Dual Temperature Rule
rules.body: Structural UI (backgrounds, borders, generic text) lives in cool indigo-slate. Game-world content (stats, spells, rules, lore) lives in warm amber-earth. The temperature shift tells the reader whether they're looking at interface or content without any other signal.

rules.name: The Gold Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Signal Gold (#FFD400) appears only in progress bars and trigger button rings. It is never used for text, backgrounds, or generic accent. Its visual weight comes from being the single saturated fill in an otherwise muted system.

rules.name: The Uppercase Signpost Rule
rules.body: Every label is uppercase with positive letter-spacing (0.04em-1px). This is the single strongest signal that distinguishes navigational text from content text. Never use uppercase for body or value tiers.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not float. Cards sit flush with their background; the only depth signal is the background color step between nesting levels. If it looks lifted, it's wrong. The stat-press shadow is the single carved exception.

dos: Do use tonal stepping (indigo-slate → slate-mid → slate-light) for depth hierarchy instead of shadows.
Do keep interactive elements visually quiet at rest. Borders present but low-contrast; backgrounds transparent or matching surface.
Do separate structural UI (cool indigo-slate) from game content (warm amber-earth) by color temperature.
Do use uppercase + letter-spacing exclusively for labels and navigation, never for body text or values.
Do inherit Obsidian's font stacks and sizing vars (--font-text, --font-interface, --size-*) wherever possible.
Do use light-dark() for game-world content colors that need both theme variants in a single declaration.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for all transitions (progress fills, hover lifts, focus rings).
donts: Don't add box-shadows for depth or layering. The system is flat. The stat-press and trigger-glow are the only sanctioned shadows.
Don't use SaaS patterns: white/blue blandness, rounded card grids with hero metrics, corporate neutrality. This is not a dashboard.
Don't compete for visual attention with neon colors, aggressive borders, or multiple saturated accents on the same surface. Density is not clutter.
Don't leave elements unstyled or skeletal. Every component earns its visual presence through deliberate choices, even when those choices are minimal.
Don't use Signal Gold (#FFD400) outside of progress bars and trigger button rings. Its scarcity is load-bearing.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or containers.
Don't introduce glassmorphism, gradient text, or gradient backgrounds. The system's warmth comes from color temperature, not effects.
Don't override Obsidian's native theme variables for structural elements (backgrounds, borders) outside the plugin's scoped containers.
